name: bsd-family
objective: Extend the existing operating-system family API to recognize BSD platforms. Add OperatingSystem.BSD with stable value bsd and an is_bsd convenience property, and make get_operating_system classify exactly FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD and DragonFly as BSD. Preserve existing case-sensitive Windows/Linux/Darwin behavior and OTHER fallback, all existing enum values and boolean properties. Coordinate the model and detection behavior; do not change tests or global platform state.
oracle:
from unittest.mock import patch
from devtools.core.system import OperatingSystem,get_operating_system
assert hasattr(OperatingSystem,'BSD'),'Missing BSD family'
assert OperatingSystem.BSD.value=='bsd' and str(OperatingSystem.BSD)=='bsd'
for name in ('FreeBSD','OpenBSD','NetBSD','DragonFly'):
    with patch('devtools.core.system.detection.platform.system',return_value=name):
        assert get_operating_system() is OperatingSystem.BSD
for name,expected in [('Windows',OperatingSystem.WINDOWS),('Linux',OperatingSystem.LINUX),('Darwin',OperatingSystem.MACOS),('windows',OperatingSystem.OTHER),('freebsd',OperatingSystem.OTHER),('FreeBSD-extra',OperatingSystem.OTHER),('SunOS',OperatingSystem.OTHER),('',OperatingSystem.OTHER)]:
    with patch('devtools.core.system.detection.platform.system',return_value=name):
        assert get_operating_system() is expected
for family in OperatingSystem:
    assert family.is_bsd is (family is OperatingSystem.BSD)
assert not OperatingSystem.BSD.is_windows
assert not OperatingSystem.BSD.is_linux
assert not OperatingSystem.BSD.is_macos
print('QWEN_BEHAVIOR_PASSED')
